title: Stock magazines
intro: Upload a PDF issue of a stock magazine (e.g. Börse Online, Der Aktionär, Focus Money). The AI extracts all concrete stock recommendations with price target, stop loss, time frame and rationale. You can optionally share the analysis with all other users of the app. PDF analysis only works with Claude or Gemini.
errorProxyTimeout: Timeout at reverse proxy. Try a smaller PDF or increase proxy_read_timeout.
errorServerNoJson: Server error ({status}). Response was not JSON.
uploadProgress: PDF is being uploaded and analyzed... (may take 30-90 seconds)

uploadSection.heading: Analyze new PDF
uploadSection.hintPlaceholder: e.g. 'Focus on DACH stocks' or 'Only recommendations from p. 10'
uploadSection.providerHint: If Claude says "prompt is too long" (200K tokens), Gemini helps with ~1M context. Applies only to this analysis, does not change the default setting.
uploadSection.shareDescription: Other users will then see your analysis under "Shared". Without sharing, it is only visible to you. You can change this later at any time.

emptyMine: No own analyses yet. Upload a PDF above.
emptyShared: No analyses shared by other users yet.

detail.noRecommendations: The AI did not detect any concrete stock recommendations in this PDF.
detail.disclaimer: ⚠️ AI-extracted recommendations, not the app's own investment advice. Verify against the original magazine before deriving trades from them.
